power.reading: UNDERPOWERED — the CI is wider than the effect being hunted, so 'spans zero' is CANNOT-RESOLVE, not evidence against stacking. Do not record this as a null.

experiment: stack conversion — does realized same-team correlation convert to money?
design: WITHIN-ROSTER: each roster-season compares its own stacked weeks against its own unstacked weeks, so roster quality, manager and schedule are held fixed. Outcome is the weekly-HIGH channel (the only dollar channel this seat ever activated) plus the continuous proxy.
team_resolution_caveat: current-team labels mis-tag players who changed teams in older seasons; that misclassification is toward the NULL (real stacks land in the unstacked bucket), so a POSITIVE result survives it and a NULL here is ambiguous, not a finding.

weekly_points.label: stacked minus unstacked weekly points, within roster

weekly_high_rate.label: stacked minus unstacked weekly-HIGH rate, within roster

proxy_win_probability.label: stacked minus unstacked smoothed win PROBABILITY (proxy)

weekly_sd.label: stacked minus unstacked weekly SD (the moment stacking moves)

upper_tail_rate.label: stacked minus unstacked rate of a top-quartile week (own p75)

verdict: stacked minus unstacked weekly points, within roster: +0.1029 CI spans zero (n=14 roster-seasons) | stacked minus unstacked weekly-HIGH rate, within roster: +0.0243 CI spans zero (n=14 roster-seasons) | stacked minus unstacked smoothed win PROBABILITY (proxy): -0.0017 CI spans zero (n=14 roster-seasons) | stacked minus unstacked weekly SD (the moment stacking moves): -3.4425 CI spans zero (n=14 roster-seasons) | stacked minus unstacked rate of a top-quartile week (own p75): -0.0869 CI spans zero (n=14 roster-seasons)
installs: NOTHING. This is evidence for the graduation gate, not a weight change.
